message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I found myself scrambling for flashlights and power banks. After a bit of chaos, we ended up huddled together with some board games and a deck of cards. It was such a nice reminder of how much fun we can have without screens or gadgets. Sometimes, a little low-tech fun is just what we need to reconnect with each other. Have you had any unexpected adventures during a power outage?
